recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast graphic composition featuring a large-scale red, white, and black checkerboard grid in the background. The top half is dominated by ornate, Victorian-inspired custom lettering on a curved banner, while the bottom half features a dark photographic strip showing figures engulfed in vertical light streaks or flames.
coreVisualRelationships: Ornate typography contrasting with a rigid geometric grid
Warm fire-like photographic elements against a cold black background
Curved banner shapes breaking the horizontal and vertical lines of the checkerboard
High-contrast color palette of primary red, black, and white
coreInvariants: Victorian scrollwork and flourishes around the main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typography is the primary subject, occupying the top 40% of the frame. The photographic strip occupies the middle 40%, with the remaining space used for secondary metadata.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, ornate numeral and the central curved banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-center title, follow the curve of the banner down to the left, then scan across the photographic figures at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized within the white squares of the checkerboard to provide breathing room for complex typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red and high value white create a vibrating optical effect against deep black.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses high-contrast serifs with thick vertical strokes and thin horizontals
Ornate flourishes and scrolls integrated into the letterforms
Secondary text follows a curved baseline within a ribbon graphic
Metadata uses a wide, low-profile, geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerals are highly stylized with internal decorative lines
Letters are warped to fit the arc of a banner
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate, decorative display type paired with ultra-modern, wide geometric sans-serif for a 'future-retro' look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical look of the metadata text
Captures the ornate, high-contrast feel of the main title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a large-scale red, white, and black checkerboard pattern. In the center horizontal third, place a dark photographic strip featuring five figures in motion, each overlaid with vertical orange and yellow light streaks resembling flames.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large arched banner across the top half. Place ornate, high-contrast Victorian-style lettering inside the banner. Add wide, geometric sans-serif text in the top corners for technical metadata.

verificationChecks: Is the checkerboard pattern large and high-contrast?
Does the main title follow a curved path?
Are the photographic figures engulfed in vertical light effects?
Is the color palette strictly red, white, black, and amber?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red is a vibrant primary red.
Check that the text arch doesn't obscure the photographic figures.
Verify the Victorian scrolls are integrated into the lettering.
Confirm the checkerboard grid aligns horizontally and vertically.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Geometric Pattern] background with [Victorian Scrollwork] typography and a [Long Exposure/Fire] photographic strip.
